hero.tagline: Tech-savvy and hands-on: I build practical tools, automate repetitive tasks, and keep projects moving across software and hardware. When I’m not fixing things, I tinker with pixel art and hardware projects.

about.title: About
about.intro: I prefer solutions that are reliable day-to-day: clear, repeatable processes and small tools that solve problems without adding overhead.
about.me.title: About me
about.me.intro: I keep systems running - servers, automation and small scripts that reduce manual work. I aim for reliable, maintainable solutions, favour clear logging and predictable behavior, and try to avoid unnecessary complexity.
about.journey.title: Journey
about.journey.intro: I started my IT journey in elementary school, making game projects on Scratch and teaching myself HTML, JavaScript and CSS. I later completed vocational studies and focused on system administration, networking and applied tooling.
about.journey.outro: My background mixes formal training with self-directed projects: home servers, small-scale networks, device repair, and automation that keeps services reliable without constant babysitting.
about.work.title: What I work on
about.work.intro: My practical focus is backend and systems work: service orchestration, game-server hosting, and small services and bridges. I also do hardware-level tinkering.
about.highlights.title: Project highlights
about.outside.title: Outside of work
about.outside.intro: I prefer solo hobbies where I can practice, iterate and be better than yesterday. I’m into pixel art and DJ mixing.

contact.intro: Thanks for stopping by. Whether it's a commission, a collaboration, a question about my work, or just a friendly hello - I love hearing from people.

project.grantargo.title: Grantargó Kft. - Website development
project.grantargo.desc: Designed and implemented the corporate website: layout, responsive styles, and deployment pipelines to keep the site fast and maintainable.
project.worktime.title: C# GUI - Worktime document generator (Windows)
project.worktime.desc: A small Windows tool that automates worktime document creation by querying calendar/holiday APIs and producing formatted outputs for reporting.
project.sys.title: Systems & Automation
project.sys.desc: Infrastructure work: orchestration, monitoring and small automation pieces that reduce manual intervention and improve reliability.
project.chatbots.title: Community chatbots - Discord
project.chatbots.desc: Built and maintained chatbots for several small Discord communities, adding moderation, utility commands, and custom interactions.
project.network.title: Network design & implementation (multi-site)
project.network.desc: Planned and deployed a network for a fictional company across three buildings using Cisco routers/switches and mixed OS servers; reproduced in Packet Tracer and on real devices, with on-site and AWS EC2 components.
project.iot.title: IoT projects - Arduino & Raspberry Pi
project.iot.desc: Designed and built IoT devices for hobby and school projects using Arduino microcontrollers and Raspberry Pi modules for sensing, automation, and data logging.
project.gameserver.title: Game server deployment - Minecraft Java
project.gameserver.desc: Deployed and managed game servers with performance tuning, backups and plugin maintenance for multiplayer communities.
project.hardware.title: Hardware diagnostics & maintenance
project.hardware.desc: Diagnosed and repaired Android devices, laptops, and PCs; performed maintenance such as re-pasting CPUs, cleaning cooling systems, and component replacement.
project.support.title: Community technical support & advice
project.support.desc: Provided technical support and preventative guidance to small communities, resolving issues and reducing recurring problems through configuration and best practices.
project.teaching.title: Teaching - microcontrollers & programming basics
project.teaching.desc: Delivered lessons to younger learners on microcontrollers and programming fundamentals, creating hands-on exercises and simple projects.
about.home_server.title: Home-server orchestration
about.home_server.desc: I run and maintain a multi-service home server that hosts game instances, bots and personal projects. I focus on reproducible deployment and monitoring so services stay online with minimal intervention.>
about.discord.title: Discord bridge & automation
about.discord.desc: Small tooling that connects services and automates routine tasks - status bridges, alerts and lightweight bots. These are practical tools: small, well-logged, and designed to fail gracefully.
about.personality.title: Personality (INTJ‑T)
about.personality.desc: I’m strategic, analytical and private by default, though I’m friendly and I try my best in social interactions. I prefer written, specific communication and clear goals over vague discussion. Strengths include systems thinking, long-term planning, and a focus on efficient, reliable solutions. I can sometimes come across as blunt or skip formalities, but I aim to be considerate and clear in collaboration.
about.values.title: Values
about.values.desc: I support the right-to-repair movement and follow creators like Salem Techsperts - practical repair and preservation matter to me. I value competence, autonomy and tools that empower sustained use over disposable convenience.
